models.name: GR00T
models.protocol: VLA 5/5 FPS, H1, RGB224, native state/action 17 / 6; L0/B/F 20 episodes, seeds 42–61, cap 1000. B/F RTX 3090 measured-only, one worker. P 5×10 episodes. E10 simulated IID; seeds 104771–104780 repeat first ten selection seeds. Historical L0 teacher 125/125 FPS, n=10. P raw-step cap: 900.
models.training: Fresh VLA 5,000 updates, seed 42, global 64; DiT-B, 4 inference timesteps / 8 diffusion repeats. Profile micro 32 × accumulation 1 × two GPUs. Fresh APPO 10M, seed 0; training-best selected at step 14536 / 7442432 frames.
models.data: L0 reused 100 source episodes, 90/10 split, 85,160/9,664 rows; clock metadata 125→5 only. Profile strict >3000:100 accepted /100 attempts; 90,000/10,000 rows.
limitations: L0/P/B/E/F audited; compact evidence published.
Returns are mean ± population SD across episodes from one training run; no controlled architecture ranking or equal-latency causal claim.
L0 teacher is the historical shared source teacher at its original clock, not reevaluated at the current VLA clock.
Teacher return gates apply to demonstrations, not VLA acceptance. Native clipping is preserved; logged actions can be preclip commands.
E10 repeats selection seeds; it is not independent validation.
Full runtime traces were audited server-side; compact publication does not contain every raw trace.
